title: cynanchum sublanceolatum var. auriculatum
intro: Cynanchum sublanceolatum var. auriculatum, commonly known as the auriculated milkvine, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum sublanceolatum var. auriculatum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cardiovascular protective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
